description: Creates (or with overwrite, replaces) an environment file with variable names and non-secret values, e.g. baseUrl. Secret keys are declared without values (secret: true) and added to .env.example; the user puts the real values in the git-ignored .env. Variables whose names look secret (token, password, key, …) are always treated as secrets and their values are not written.
name: create_environment

missingInDotEnv.description: Secret keys the user still has to add to .env

movedToSecrets.description: Names that looked secret; their values were not written

title: Create an environment
